data.text: Future releases: stage the package with npm's stage publish command, then the maintainer (Leon) approves via passkey on npmjs.com. This avoids 2FA codes in chat or tokens in version control.
data.rationale: npm deprecated TOTP and token-bypass methods; passkey is the only option, and staged publishing is npm's workflow for it.

evidence: User ran `npm profile enable-2fa auth-and-writes` → 'Adding a new TOTP 2FA is no longer supported' 404; Leo then used `npx npm@latest stage publish` twice successfully; approval via iPhone passkey worked; PLAN.md documents this

data.spec: MCP server name in registry.modelcontextprotocol.io must be exactly `io.github.Leonhest/hivemind` (case-sensitive). Must also match mcpName field in package.json and server.json. Registry publish fails with 403 if name doesn't match account username case (`Leonhest` not `leonhest`).

evidence: mcp-publisher publish with lowercase name → 403 'You have permission to publish: io.github.Leonhest/*'; fixed by updating mcpName to 'io.github.Leonhest/hivemind' in package.json and server.json; v0.1.1 published successfully; curl to registry confirms 'io.github.Leonhest/hivemind'

data.title: Privacy & security: public-repo notice, secret scrubbing, enable/disable

evidence: Version 0.1.3 published to npm, all tests pass: 'Tests 44 passed (44)', verified on public (Leonhest/hivemind) and private (hivemind-spike) repos.

data.spec: export function findRepo(cwd: string, opts: { includeDisabled?: boolean } = {}): Repo | null; When opts.includeDisabled is false (default), returns null if hivemind is disabled for that clone (via `hivemind disable`). When true, returns the Repo even if disabled (used internally for enable/disable commands).

evidence: findRepo signature updated: 'export function findRepo(cwd: string, opts: { includeDisabled?: boolean } = {}): Repo | null'

data.spec: export const isEnabled = (root: string) => tryGit(root, ['config', '--bool', 'hivemind.enabled']) !== 'false'; export function setEnabled(repo: Repo, enabled: boolean): void; export function githubSlug(remoteUrl: string): string | null; githubSlug returns 'owner/name' for GitHub remotes, else null.

evidence: New functions defined in git.ts: isEnabled, setEnabled, githubSlug with complete implementations.

data.spec: `hivemind disable` turns hivemind off for the current clone (stores in .git/config, kills daemon). `hivemind enable` turns it back on. Both print confirmation to stdout. `hivemind status` shows current visibility (PUBLIC, private, or no visibility info).

evidence: Case statements added: 'case 'disable': ... case 'enable': ... setEnabled(repo, enabled)'

data.spec: src/core/redact.ts applies regex patterns to every plan entry before write: (1) Private keys (PEM format). (2) API keys: sk-*, pk-*, rk-*, gh*, npm_, AKIA*, xox*. (3) JWTs (eyJ...). (4) Password/connection-string credentials: 'user:password@host' → 'user:[redacted]@host', 'password = value' → 'password = [redacted]. (5) Named fields: password, secret, api_key, access_token, auth_token, client_secret.

evidence: Redact test cases: '[redacted]' → '[redacted]', 'postgres://app:[redacted]@db' → 'postgres://app:[redacted]@db', 'password = [redacted]' → 'password = [redacted]

data.text: Visibility detection runs in background daemon (~1.5s max on first session, cached 24h). Prevents surprise public leaks.
data.rationale: Transparency: agents should know when their plan is publicly visible so they can make informed decisions about what to write.

evidence: Hook modified: 'await Promise.race([refreshVisibility(repo).catch(() => {}), new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1_500))])'; verified on Leonhest/hivemind (shows notice) and Leonhest/hivemind-spike (doesn't).

data.spec: The `hivemind` CLI works from any subfolder within a git repo and automatically discovers the repo root. Outside a git repo or in a repo without an `origin` remote, the CLI is inactive.

evidence: Each repo has its own plan, so `hivemind` works out which plan to show from the folder you're in. Run it anywhere inside the repo, including subfolders... Outside a git repo, or in one with no `origin` remote, it just says hivemind is inactive there.

data.text: When decomposing work, use: goal_set for goals, contract_publish for interfaces, decision_log for choices, and task_add for unassigned tasks. Teammates' agents claim them with task_claim by key.
data.rationale: Separates work planning from assignment, lets each agent see full scope before claiming.

evidence: When the user asks you to plan or split up work, record the plan in hivemind: goal_set for goals, contract_publish for the interfaces between pieces, decision_log for choices, and task_add for the tasks

data.spec: Input schema: { key: string, text: string, alongside?: boolean, replaces?: string[] }. When goals already exist: requires either alongside=true (marks as competing proposal, adds to alternative_to field) or replaces=['key1','key2',...] (removes old goals, clears alternative_to). Same-key updates require no decision. Output includes hints about conflicting goals. Competing goals are flagged at the top of the plan summary with '⚠️ Competing goals: the team hasn't picked one yet (goal1 vs goal2)'.

evidence: "expect((await call('goal_set', { key: 'phone-agent', text: 'Negotiate by phone', alongside: true })).text).toContain('competing proposal')" and "const res = await call('goal_set', { key: 'phone-agent', text: 'Negotiate by phone (team decided)', replaces: ['email-agent'] }); expect(res.text).toConta

data.spec: Input schema: { key: string, text: string, replaces?: string[] }. Tool shows existing decisions in hint text so agents can spot contradictions. replaces parameter removes old decisions from the plan. Invalid replaces keys return error 'Nothing to replace'.

evidence: "const hint = await call('decision_log', { key: 'hosting', text: 'Deploy on Fly' }); expect(hint.text).toContain('Existing decisions: "db"')" and "await call('decision_log', { key: 'db-neon', text: 'Neon Postgres for everything', replaces: ['db'] })"

data.spec: export function askModel(backend: Backend, system: string, schema: object, prompt: string, opts: ModelOptions = {}): Promise<any>; export interface ModelOptions { model?: string; thinking?: boolean; }. For claude backend: model defaults to env.HIVEMIND_CLAUDE_MODEL ?? opts.model ?? 'haiku'; thinking defaults to true (hidden thinking enabled) but can disable with opts.thinking=false. For codex backend: opts parameter accepted but unused.

evidence: "export interface ModelOptions { model?: string; thinking?: boolean; }" and "const out = await askModel(backend, SYSTEM, SCHEMA, `Plan entries...`, { model: process.env.HIVEMIND_REVIEW_MODEL ?? 'sonnet', thinking: false })"

data.spec: Goal (and potentially decision/contract) entries now have optional data field alternative_to: string[]. Contains keys of competing entries. When displayed, the summary filters alternative_to to only include keys that are still open in the plan, so resolving a competition (via replaces or update) automatically clears the field.

evidence: "const openGoals = new Set([...reduce(ops).values()].filter((e) => e.kind === 'goal' && e.status === 'open').map((e) => e.key)); ...alternative_to: (e.data.alternative_to as string[]).filter((k) => openGoals.has(k))"
